claimLabels.EXT: Source-reported metadata, source rights statements, catalogue information, and the scope of searches actually performed; not independent acoustic measurements.
claimLabels.MEAS: Deterministic counts and sums of source-reported durations.
claimLabels.INFERENCE: Editorial priorities, selection reasons, completeness inferred from track inventories, performance grouping where not explicit, and provisional quality grades.

rightsPolicy.commons: Commons licence governs eligibility under the lead’s explicit decision. PD-EU-audio sources are included with territorial: true; this is not a declaration of US public-domain status.
rightsPolicy.archive: Require a PD/CC licence URL or documented US publication in or before 1925. Restrictive NC/ND licences are not selected. Questionable PD/CC0 marks on later commercial Ravel/Rachmaninoff recordings are flagged and excluded, not treated as permission from the record label.
rightsPolicy.ownRachmaninoff: Selected own-performance tracks are Victor/Edison acoustic sessions reported before 1926, from an opened Archive item carrying a Public Domain Mark. No recording year is relabelled as a publication year; no unsupported US-cutoff rights object is invented.
rightsPolicy.rolls: Only acoustic recordings of real reproducing pianos qualify, explicitly labelled as rolls. Neither old rolls nor software realisations clear rights in a later sound recording.

method.sourcesOpened: Every accepted file was checked with audio.mjs check or archive-files. Source URLs record the opened Commons API file identity or Archive metadata. Full Commons pages/revisions were additionally opened to resolve territorial licences and performers omitted by machine-readable metadata.
method.sourceChecks: File existence, reported duration, MP3 derivative or MP3 filename, and licence/basis were checked. No complete audio was downloaded or auditioned; no DSP, local model, build, validator, or test was run.
method.quality: All quality enums are explicitly provisional INFERENCE grades; actual sound quality, undocumented cuts, speed, noise and performance merit are unknown unless a source-specific note says otherwise.
method.completeness: complete means the work inventory is covered, including explicitly referenced existing tracks where necessary. Existing tracks are not repeated in movements or totals. Gaspard is complete only as a labelled mixed-performance assembly; Tombeau, Rückert-Lieder and Mother Goose remain incomplete.
method.recentSearch: An explicit 2026 public-domain search preceded historical discographic work. The opened UCSB 2026 notice establishes the current sound-recording cutoff; it does not clear later recordings.
method.durationPrecision: Commons tool durations are rounded to seconds; Archive decimal durations are retained. Total minutes sum these metadata values, not new acoustic measurements.

summary.countingUnit: One new streamable complete movement or short piece; alternatives included, existing tracks excluded. Distinct work-performance programmes are counted separately.
